jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
As a Senior DevOps engineer, you will focus your technical expertise on evaluating and streamlining existing processes, identifying bottlenecks and working around them to improve overall operational efficiency.

Responsibilties:
• Identifying bottlenecks in current practices and addressing these by designing automation around Kubernetes infrastructure management, continuous integration pipelines and deployment strategies for containerised workloads, multi-tenant services and shared applications to meet time constraints.
• On other days you’ll be evaluating and driving forward, as necessary, new technologies, tools or frameworks to improve system performance and/or operational efficiency, always focusing on quality.
• Work with Solution Architects, and the rest of the DevOps teams’ members and act as a technical authority and define standards for the rest of the operational teams. On a different front, mentor and collaborate, setting clear and tangible requirements for the success of... the organisation.
• Holds SRE practices at heart and strongly believes good observability practices lead to an intimate understanding of platform behaviour and performance, with which one may also proactively detect problems in not-so-familiar systems.
• The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of both operational and containerisation principles, together with a proven track record of designing and delivering solutions to maintain reliable and resilient platforms.
• Previous technical experience in a senior DevOps role.
• Deep understanding of the following:
• Container platforms
• CI/CD toolchains and related practices
• Infrastructure as Code and Templating (Ansible, Terraform, Helm, Kustomize)
• Cryptography (digital certificates, key exchanges, encryption)
• Solid Linux knowledge, including filesystems, day-to-day administration cli tools, package management, patching, regex, scripting etc..
• Grasp of networking concepts, including TCP/IP layers, Load Balancers, reverse proxies, firewalling and packet inspection practices.
• Experience building, deploying, maintaining, and operating SaaS products in a cost effective manner.
• Sound understanding of the software development ecosystem: use of Git, automated testing, environment promotion, scrum methodologies etc.
• Ability to articulate technical documentation and design architecture blueprints.
• Ability to understand and capture value in emerging technologies through research.
• Concise communication and presentation skills, ability to explain complex problems effortlessly to both techies & non-technical colleagues.
• Able to work effectively in a team environment and devoted knowledge sharer.

Nice to have:
• Certifications related to the demonstrated skills that can be verified.
• Familiarity with public cloud platforms.
• Exciting opportunities for career growth
• Flexible hybrid work model
• Comprehensive international health insurance
• Health and wellbeing package worth 350 EUR per year
• Day off on your birthday
• 1 additional day off for yourself "Me Time"
• Complimentary office lunches

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
jobs_results.description:
TransPerfect Is More Than Just a Job…
Our greatest asset is our people, and nothing is more important to us than ensuring that everyone knows that. Each of our 90+ offices has its own individual identity, and each also has its own unique rewards.

We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer to join the Artificial Intelligence team at TransPerfect and build services in Golang, NodeJS, Python, C++, and Kubernetes for millions of users.

You’d be part of a team developing our GlobalLink AI suite, that includes a web portal, APIs, and a scalable artificial intelligence platform based on microservices for which we use a state-of-the-art tech stack, including Kubernetes and Docker containers. Your goal will be to improve our CD/CI approach, automate the operations, and enable the platform to exponentially scale.

You’ll fit within our team if you love solving challenges, you want to make an impact working for the top brands in the world, and you are ambitious and detail oriented. You’ll need to... work with a variety of teams in the US, Europe, and Asia, and make things better every day.

To find out more about our solutions, please visit: https://globallink.transperfect.com/

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design and operations of our cloud infrastructure (dev, production, QA) in Amazon Web Services and our colocation.
• Run applications on an orchestration platform using tools like Kubernetes, Clipper, and Docker to ensure at least a 99.5% availability.
• Ensure appropriate monitoring and logging, as well as create the right tools for developers to own their pieces of the code with the most autonomy.

Skills and Experience:
• Experience with at least two of the programming languages above and also bash in Linux environments.
• Experience on Kubernetes, Docker, monitoring tools, and CD/CI.
• Good knowledge of AWS.
• Can-do attitude to communicate within a diverse team of developers.
• Previous experience with high-load web applications

jobs_results.title: DEVOPS ENGINEER
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Apptiva Core Technologies, company specialized in SW development, experts in Digital Transformation, Blockchain, IoTs, NFTs, Cloud, every technology based in Javascript, Python and AWS environments.

Job Description

As a DevOps Engineer you will collaborate with product development teams. With a focus on automating builds via CI/CD pipelines and getting code into production as quickly and efficiently as possible.

As well as supporting services before they go live via system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews. You will use automation to scale systems sustainably and help to make improvements, evolving systems and driving change that improves the reliability, speed and security.

Work with IT Product teams to deploy newer version of software in Cloud resources. Collaborate with DevOps teams to make sure new environments meet requirements and conform to best practices.

Qualifications

MANDATORY:
•... Strong knowledge managing Jenkins.
• Strong knowledge writting Helm templates to deploy resources in OpenShift 4.X.
• Experience creating docker images (Dockerfiles and S2I).
• Experience deploying resources and managing them in Kubernetes/OpenShift.
• Experience in Git and Gitflows.
• Experience in Linux.
• ADVANCED English level

NICE TO HAVE:
• Knowledge deploying resources in AWS using Terraform.
• Knowledge architecting solutions in AWS.
• Knowledge in code analysis tools (Sonarqube and GHAS) and creating performance tests (Jmeter).
• Scripting using Python, Bash or similar.

Additional Information

Salary: 40.000 € - 60.000 €

jobs_results.description:
As a DevOps Engineer specializing in Azure, you will be responsible for the maintenance and evolution of our current CI/CD platform. Your primary duties will involve troubleshooting and enhancing the platform to ensure optimal performance and reliability. You will work closely with our development and operations teams to streamline processes and implement best practices.

Requirements
• Maintain and evolve the existing CI/CD platform, focusing on corrective and evolutionary maintenance.
• Demonstrate expertise in Kubernetes, Helm, YAML, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and various Azure artifacts (e.g., storage account, web apps).
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and address platform issues and improvements.
• Implement automation and orchestration techniques to streamline deployment and management processes.
• Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues as needed.
• Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in DevOps and Azure technologies.

Benefits
•... Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, with a focus on Azure technologies.
• Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, YAML, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and Azure artifacts.
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
• Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team environment.
• Good communication skills and ability to interact effectively with stakeholders.
• Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines

jobs_results.description:
JAVA DEVELOPER WITH DEVOPS SKILLS

Desde Capgemini Engineering queremos incorporar a nuestro equipo un/a Desarrollador/a Java con Devops Skills que quiera seguir creciendo profesionalmente en una Empresa Familiarmente Responsable y Top Employer.

Requisitos
• Experiencia de al menos 1 año desarrollando Java con Spring boot.
• Experiencia con Docker y Kubernetes.
• Conocimientos de configuración de pipelines en Git.
• Nivel de inglés alto (B2-C1)

Funciones

La persona que se incorpore se encargará del:
• Desarrollo de nuevos componentes en Java.
• Manejo de Kubernetes y containers (despliegue de pods, services, ingress, portforwarding, configuración de .yaml)
• Manejo de Helm chart para test y creación de paquetes (configuración de .yaml).
• Testing en Cucumber (Typescript y Java).

Se ofrece
• Contrato Indefinido
• Seguro de vida y accidentes
• Tickets restaurante
• Tickest guardería
• Sistema de compra de días de vacaciones adicionales.
• Retribución flexible (seguro médico... guardería, transporte, formación).
• Flexibilidad horaria, nos importa la conciliación y que tengas un equipo entre la vida personal y profesional.
• Posibilidad de teletrabajar.
• Formación continua, podrás disfrutar de Mylearning y de Capgemini University con acceso a plataformas como: Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, harvard Manager Mentor, entre otros.
• Formación en idiomas con acceso a cursos de Inglés, Francés y Alemán.

jobs_results.title: DevOps & Kubernetes Engineer (Temporary)
jobs_results.description:
The Position

As DevOps & Kubernetes Engineer will play a main role in the creation and adoption of a devops mindset in different development teams, providing guidance and support for understanding how to develop and deploy cloud native applications that will consistently run on a kubernetes based environment.

You will also contribute to the evolution, maintenance and continuous improvement of Container as a Service (CaaS) ecosystem on hybrid cloud deployment, ensuring services meet operational targets, and achieve high availability and performance in meeting Roche’s business needs.

You will be part of the CaaS Product team, a global team with members in EMEA, NALA and ASIA. Your mail role will be connecting and supporting our internal consumers, including helping them to understand and translate business demand into technical solutions, and being the link between developers and CaaS Product Team

You will also work with the developers in guiding them to create and deploy cloud... native applications and how to operate successfully in a kubernetes environment, both in cloud (AWS) and on premise.

All this, you will perform for the good of the patients, in a leading global healthcare company

Who are we and how do we work?

The CaaS (Container as a Service) Product team is an infrastructure team that delivers and maintains high available kubernetes platform for multiple applications in Roche.

For that purpose we provide automated processes and ensure our platform works seamlessly for our users, including a global toolchain (security, monitoring, logging, SSO etc.)

We work following agile principles.

Required Experience
• 4+ years of professional experience in DevOps, 5+ years in IT in general.
• Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
• CKAD - Certified Kubernetes Application Developer is a plus.
• Programming skills in scripting languages like Python, Bash.
• Expert knowledge of implementing CI/CD pipelines and delivering reliable software from development to production.
• Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation (Ansible, Terraform).
• Strong knowledge of infrastructure and networking (DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Routing, Web).
• Good knowledge of Linux systems.
• Experience in DevOps teams organization, DevOps toolchain implementation.
• Knowledge of tools used in the CaaS Ecosystem (Rancher, Portworx, Aqua, Nexus, Elastic)
• Experience with cloud platforms - preferably AWS is a plus.
• Highly fluent oral and written communication skills in English
• Very good communication skills and willingness to interact with development teams and help them to adopt best cloud native based development and deployment practices
• Strong team oriented mindset.
• Innovative and ability to think outside the box for creative problem solving
• Ability to learn and propose new technologies/tools and teach how to integrate them to other users/teams
• Experience working in Agile Teams. SAFe is a plus.

Accountabilities
• Guide, support and closely collaborate with development and infrastructure teams.
• Mentoring and sharing DevOps culture and knowledge with your colleagues
• Building and enhancing large-scale platforms and applications.
• Establish best practices for consistency among software development teams.
• Designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines across the organization.
• Identifying and implementing automation strategies that ensure high quality and speed up delivery of new solutions.
• Consistently deliver robust, high-quality, reliable outcomes in cross functional autonomous agile teams.
• Drive scripting and IaC development to achieve the highest levels of automation and use of APIs, enabling continuous integration and delivery.
• Manage CaaS-as-a-Service delivery, systems reliability and scalability including: configuration, building, testing, planning, and deployment of complex solutions
• Install, configure, upgrade, troubleshoot, and proactively monitor and ensure performance, availability and capacity.
• Comply with OLAs and quality and validation requirements.

"At Roche, we believe in diversity and inclusion as essential values for our success. We have special
interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. If you have a disability, forus it is a plus, and
we have special benefits for you: Go ahead and present your candidacy!

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.title: DevOps/SRE Engineering - Enhancing Digital Experiences
jobs_results.description:
We have a fantastic new opportunity for a DevOps/SRE Engineer to revolutionise Digital Experience Analytics!

Our SaaS platform provides deep user experience analytics for our enterprise clients, 30% of whom are part of the Fortune 100! We utilise state of the art insights and Machine Learning to enable automatic recommendations and unique improvement suggestions to increase engagement, brand growth and revenue.

We've received more than $800 Million in funding and have expanded globally, targeting a hyper-growth with close to 1,500 hires benchmarked in the coming years!

We are now building a brand new development team in Barcelona - we've already hired amazing engineers from Ocado, Adevinta, Adyen and now's your chance to join this incredibly talented team!

This is a phenomenal opportunity to work on systems of non-trivial scale and complexity and have real scope for growth as you'll be part of our technical decisions as one of the first engineers in the team in Barcelona.

Our... tech stack:

Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Python, Go, AWS, Azure and more!

At the heart of it, we're looking for talented Engineers from versatile backgrounds who are interested in learning new languages and tools.

Responsibilities

We are looking for talented people who are confident working across different aspects of development and are looking to step up into the next stage of their career.

We have roles in our:

Cloud Foundation Team: working on observability, monitoring, logging, networking and more.

Cloud Services Team: working on containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure, automation tools and more.

Cloud Product Team: supporting our data and application teams and working on data streams with Kafka and our infrastructure.

Regardless of the team, our engineers have the freedom and flexibility to move between different projects. What's consistent throughout is the main challenges are on data volume, scalability issues and performance issues.

Some of the things you'd be working on include:

• Ensuring other R&D teams use Infrastructure as defined by the IaC

• Ensuring all metrics and logs are available to allow the building and relevant monitoring of dashboards by other members of the R&D

• Supervise big, cross R&D projects to improve the velocity, quality and cost of our platform

• Bridging the gap between developers and operations by closely working with other R&D teams on their projects

• Work with developers in supporting new features, services, software releases and troubleshoot problems

• Choosing the best hosting options to fit the best current needs and embrace our long-term business vision and impact the business through technology and new ideas

• Drive core-edge technologies at scale

• You will also develop skills on technologies such as: Elasticsearch, Kafka, ClickHouse, Hadoop/Spark, CDNs, DNS, Load Balancers, Monitoring, Logs, etc.

Benefits

• Competitive salary + stock options

• Hybrid working

• Working on a variety of cool projects e.g. applications with intensive data visualisations

• Exposure to the complexities of working with some of the biggest sites, apps and brands in the world

• You’ll be joining a company that has seen incredible growth and market traction

• You’ll be joining a company that truly cares about its employees and works hard to make sure your efforts are rewarded.

Want to be a part of the digital revolution?

Then what are you waiting for, click apply and let’s see what you’ve got

jobs_results.title: Microservices/DevOps Developer (Python)
jobs_results.description:
Req ID: 303945
Red Bee Media is the world’s leading Managed Service provider to the media industry. Working with the best media brands in the world, we enrich and ensure media experiences.

Every day, people on all continents watch television programs prepared, managed and broadcast by Red Bee Media staff. Every year, the business delivers more than 2.7 million hours of programming in more than 60 languages for nearly 600 TV channels.

We’re looking to bring in skilled, collaborative developers to share knowledge and work with exciting new technologies to create innovative solutions to make media accessible to deaf and blind audiences, as well as understanding how these technologies can enhance the value and use of media more widely.

This role works as part of the Access Services department who provides over 230,000 hours of captioning each year – more than 100,000 hours of which is live. They also provide Audio Description and signing services, making the media and the world more... accessible for the deaf and hard of hearing and hard of sight.

What do we expect from you?

The role will require feature development from base requirements and user stories, coordination with test leads and product owners to validate progress, and deployment into test and production environments. Additionally, the role will require developing integration with related systems (e.g. client scheduling software, production software) and for ensuring the optimal configuration is achieved for use in production.

What we offer:
Permanent contract
Competitive Salary Package
Stable employment on the basis of an employment contract
You will benefit from a wide range of learning opportunities and knowledgeable colleagues
clearly defined career paths
Work-based on developing the latest solutions in the area of mobile technology
Work from home, flexible working hours, laptop and mobile phone.
Work-life balance

jobs_results.description:
ELK-Stack, Grafana, Continuous Integration, Docker,Infrastructure as Code, Istio, Kubernetes, Prometheus, IT,Deployment, Ansible, Softwareentwicklung, Continuous Deployment,On-Premise, Datenwiederherstellung, Monitoring, Jenkins, Terraform,DevOps, GitLab

DevOps Engineer (m / w / d) Digital Health

MEDIAN Unternehmenszentrale Berlin

MEDIAN is one of Europe's leadingproviders of medical rehabilitation and mental health services.With more than 120 rehabilitation centres throughout Germany,MEDIAN offers a dynamic and innovative environment for employees ina wide range of areas with a variety of job opportunities anddevelopment opportunities for applicants.

Specialising inrehabilitation and participation, we accompany our patients on theroad to recovery and back into society - in line with our guidingprinciple of "Living life".

We are looking assoon as possible for a DevOps Engineer (m / w / d) Digital Health.

Your main tasks
• Build, manage and maintain a self-hosted... Kubernetesecosystem for our services
• Lead thedevelopment and implementation of Infrastructure as Code solutionsusing tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation to automatethe provisioning of infrastructure
• Establishrobust monitoring, alerting, and log management systems toproactively identify and resolve issues, ensuring high availabilityand performance
• Implement security bestpractices across the infrastructure, applications, and deploymentprocesses, including vulnerability assessments and compliancechecks
• Collaborate with cross-functionalteams, including developers and system administrators, to ensureseamless integration of DevOps practices into the softwaredevelopment lifecycle

Yourprofile
• Several years ofexperience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering role,demonstrating a strong background in infrastructure and deploymentautomation
• Proficiency in Infrastructure asCode (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation
• Expertise in setting up and managing CI / CDpipelines, using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or CircleCI
• In-depth knowledge of containerizationtechnologies (Docker) and container orchestration systems(Kubernetes) and their related technologies (Docker Compose,Istio / Linkerd, Cert-Manager, etc.)
• Experience with on-premise / self-hosting
• Thorough understanding of security best practices and experienceimplementing security measures within DevOps processes
• Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g.,Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
• Familiaritywith tracing tools (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin, OpenTelemetry)
• Strong problem-solving skills and theability to troubleshoot complex issues
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills

We offer you the following benefits
• Opportunity to develop onedigital health solution from scratch and bring another to the nextlevel
• 200.000+ own patients per year waitingfor our digital health solutions
• Medicaldoctors, psychologist and therapists in 125+ MEDIAN clinicsproviding expert input
• Flat hierarchies withdirect access to MEDIAN’s top management
• Agreat team working with startup speed and mindset while benefitingfrom the established structures of one of Germany’s largest clinicgroups

Have we raised yourinterest?

Then we look forward to receiveyour comprehensive online application, stating your salaryexpectations and your possible starting date, exclusively via ourjob portal !

Mr. Max Reichel, Human Resources Manager,will be happy to answer your questions on the phone
